zh: Dragon Claw 现在能直接改数据导入的整条指标规则：新增、修改（条件列、取值列、类型、聚合方式、子指标等）或删除，审批卡会显示每条改了哪些字段，以及按最近一次导入算出的改前 / 改后值和命中行数；每次改动都有记录，可以一键回退，之后被别人改过的规则不会被覆盖。仅管理员可用。
数据抓取脚本的保存和移动在「自动」模式下也会先弹确认卡，可选本对话总是允许。
en: Dragon Claw can now edit whole metric rules on the data import page: add, change (condition column, value column, type, aggregation, sub-metrics and more) or delete them. The approval card shows which fields change and the before / after value and matched rows from the latest import; every change is logged and can be reverted, and rules edited by someone else afterwards are never overwritten. Admins only.
Saving and moving scraping scripts now asks for confirmation in Auto mode too, with an option to always allow for the current chat.
